concept: S3 Glacier Deep Archive: cheapest multi-year archive storage
tests: Choosing a storage class for backups kept 7 years where retrieval within several hours is acceptable.
expected: S3 Glacier Deep Archive — lowest storage cost, 12–48 h retrieval. Triggers: "retained for seven years", "retrieval times of several hours", "infrequently accessed backups".
why_not: Standard and Standard-IA are much more expensive for rarely used data; the Intelligent-Tiering frequent access tier is priced like Standard.
